exercises.title: Friendship & Relationships — Reading
exercises.passage: When Dan moved to a new town, he found it difficult to make friends. He decided to join a music club. At first he avoided speaking to new people, but another student encouraged him to take part in a concert. Dan now enjoys meeting his new friends after school.

questions.question: Why did Dan join the club?
What encouraged him?
questions.answer: Another student invited him to take part in a concert

exercises.title: Friendship & Relationships — Listening
exercises.script: Olivia: I think Maya is upset with me. Noah: Have you tried talking to her? Olivia: Not yet. Noah: I suggest listening first and then explaining your side. Olivia: You are right.
exercises.audio_source: TTS script. Needs audio recording or speech synthesis integration.

questions.question: What does Noah suggest doing first?
